# Handoff restoration: actual browser and canvas comparison

Runtime source: `497a80716656b846bf1b64c63c422fc45b44cd77`. Production standalone API/Academy/Doctor, root-owned branch DB `ds_dev_2951`; root binds the six process identities, build configuration and 13/13 readiness checks in `runtime-2951`. This report is local verification; no owner Stage-B verdict or staging-slot verification is claimed.

Approved source: base-branch `design-source/auth.dc.html`, both actual host props, `screen: login`, `loginTab: otp`, `otpSent: false/true`, `dark: false/true`, responsive desktop/mobile. Exact source bytes and SHA-256 plus pure source `renderVals` extraction are preserved privately; no canvas bitmap renderer or pixel-diff was used or invented. The real screenshots were read against those bytes and source values, together with real computed geometry/styles.

Stage-A applicability: #2659's option 2 explicitly says same account goes directly to returnTo without code; another account uses the existing code step and replaces the session; no new screen or copy. The form's removal during same-account handoff is the intended visible correction. The shell remains while the existing operation resolves.

## Renders

Both hosts have these distinct actual profile files: `HOST-desktop-light-code.png`, `HOST-desktop-dark-code.png`, `HOST-mobile-light-code.png`, `HOST-mobile-dark-code.png`, and corresponding `HOST-PROFILE-request.png`. Desktop is 1440×1100; mobile 390×900. Public code renders mask only the dynamic owned-recipient sentence, in grey. Empty cells contain no OTP. Private originals and exact-address assertions are retained outside git. `manifest.json` records image hashes and every mask rectangle.

The earlier `refused-request.png` originals captured a real pending spinner. They were re-observed after an explicit enabled/non-busy assertion; the published `request.png` files are those settled captures, not the initial loading state.

## Driven behavior and interaction evidence

Normal native run exit0: eight profiles passed real signup→handoff→delivered-code entry→cabinet, same-account revisit with no form in HTML/DOM/RAF and no extra addressed mail, and unknown-reference→settled empty request→real validation. Real other-account handoff and code acceptance passed on both desktop-light hosts. No response bodies, OTP values, cookies or handoff tokens are published.

Evidence boundary: that other-account branch proves the correct other recipient, delivered-code acceptance and cabinet target. This auxiliary run did not compare session subjects before/after or replay the old cookie, so it is not fresh proof of old-session revocation.

Every visible code/request button/link/input was driven by real pointer hover/down and keyboard Tab on all eight profiles. Public `*-control*-active.png` captures plus private computed style/geometry and focus-visible records retain the results. Inputs correctly have text cursors; buttons/links pointer cursors. Primary hover changes to #0D3A77 / #AED4FB, ghost hover uses tint, footer links underline; real focus-visible records exist in every profile. Resend's initially disabled state and later enabled interactions were both driven.

Additional native branch run preserved exit1 caused solely by the verifier choosing SMS as `role=button` instead of the real `role=radio`. Before that selector failure, both hosts passed real wrong-code rejection/empty refocus, real cooldown expiry→resend→new addressed mail/notice, and back-to-request. The corrected remaining run exited0: both hosts' SMS control/hint (no send), actual same-account after screencast, one browser-local handoff-request abort per isolated context, existing network-error/retry form, and logout200. This bounded injected fault is resilience evidence, not evidence that API/IdP/provider failed.

`before-after.png` combines unscaled actual passive screencast frames. Before ca8b0ec: form visibly painted at RAF56–194ms. After497a807: the actual signed-in handoff shell has no form before the existing destination resolves. Earlier frames in the after stream contain residual pixels from the preceding real code sign-in before the new navigation painted; those are private and are not mislabelled as the handoff result. Separate final-source observer/HTML assertions establish the no-form result on all eight profiles.

No maintained source was edited, no new scenario was added, and no stand/provider/DB/foreign resource was mutated beyond owned real product requests. All browsers closed. Root retains its own runtime; this worker started no listener. Stage-B remains pending on a legitimate slot/current-head owner verdict.
